messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — SI partner wants an embargoed joint announcement tomorrow. We agreed to run a rehearsal. Can engineering, marketing, and partnerships reps dial in at 10:30 PT? Need sign-off on the release language and the SW/HW cert badging plan.
Alex: 10:30 PT works for me. Will bring the demo owner and a short checklist about the marketplace listing state.
Derek: I can do 10:30. Are we using the staged demo env or prod sandboxes? Last time cache invalidation caused flakiness.
Sophie: staging only. Derek, please scrub the demo steps and ping me if any infra gates. I'll own the runbook.
Maria: Thanks. Sophie — can you drop the rehearsal deck in the thread before 10:00 PT? Also we need the embargo time clearly stated (no leaks until 16:00 UTC).
Sophie: Uploaded deck in the calendar invite and added a one-page checklist. Key items: marketplace tile ready, SI badging assets, partner quote finalized, embargo timestamp.
Jeff: Partner legal confirmed the quote but added a small compliance line. Marketing wants final copy by 11:30 PT to prep assets. Is that compatible with the embargo?
Maria: Yes — marketing gets the copy under NDA and embargo; publication is blocked until 16:00 UTC. We need a single owner to approve final copy — assigning to Alex.
Alex: I’ll review and approve or send edits by 11:15 PT. Also need a final screenshot set (3 images) and the certified SKU codes for the HW partners.
Derek: HW SKU list attached to this thread (see snippet). QA ran a quick smoke earlier; demo latency looks stable.
Derek: ```
HW_SKUS = ["RDW-GPU-01", "RDW-GPU-02", "RDW-ACC-XL"]
DEMO_ENV = "staging-announce-2026"
```
Sophie: Nice. On certifications: do we want to push the SI badge live in the partner portal at publish time or pre-provision it visible only to partners?
Maria: Pre-provision to partners only. Public badge toggled at publication. We need a hot rollback plan if marketplace listing fails. Can eng prepare a toggle flag?
Derek: Yes, we have a feature flag in the deploy pipeline: `marketplace_publication` — default false, flip to true at T+0 once marketing confirms. I'll coordinate the toggle window.
Alex: For the rehearsal, can we run a quick dry run of the toggle flip and a mock marketplace pull? 10:45 PT right after the main run.
Jeff: Sounds good. I'll be on the call to observe packaging and social assets push. Also looping in partner PM after rehearsal for final alignment.
announce-bot: Calendar event created: "SI embargoed announcement rehearsal" 10:30 PT — invites: Maria, Alex, Derek, Sophie, Jeff.
Maria: Final ask — keep comments terse during the rehearsal. We want to simulate the live sequence (announce-bot, flag flip, badge toggle, press release scheduling). If anything fails, we fallback to 'postpone publish' and notify partner immediately.
Sophie: Got it. I'll post the rehearsal timeline in the deck: 
1) 10:30 — quick intros and checklist
2) 10:35 — demo run (staging)
3) 10:45 — toggle flip dry run
4) 10:50 — publish mock (no live traffic)
5) 11:00 — retrospective and finalize launch playbook
Maria: Perfect. See you all at 10:30. Please be punctual and bring screenshots/logs.
Alex: On it.
Jeff: 👍
Derek: 👍
